item.title: Refactor orders status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated): The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Behaviour is a refactor: observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit the work on the local branch; ship is local, do not push.

pr.body: Approach: new src/status.rs holds OrderStatus (Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash), as_str, Display, FromStr to ParseStatusError (public, implements Error), and can_transition_to for pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled. Order::status is OrderStatus. billing::pay, shipping::ship and Order::cancel check can_transition_to and keep their error text. report::status_counts keeps Vec<(String, usize)> and sorts alphabetically via as_str (a derived Ord would sort by declaration order, so it is not used). report::from_line parses via FromStr and keeps its check order and messages. OrderStatus and ParseStatusError are re-exported from lib.rs. Files: src/status.rs (new), src/lib.rs, src/order.rs, src/billing.rs, src/shipping.rs, src/report.rs, tests/orders.rs. Checks: fmt check 0, clippy -D warnings 0, cargo test 6 passing (3 unit, 3 integration). Assumptions: Order::status is a public field, so the type change breaks callers that read it as String; this was requested by the operator. Limits: the crate has no contributor guidance file. Follow-up: none.
